svg.title: TileMap editing in the 2D view
svg.desc: Proposed editor UI for G2b: a TileMapLayer selected in a 2D scene tab shows a paint bar under the scene tabs (layer switcher, Select, Paint, Line, Rect, Bucket, Picker, Eraser, random scatter, flips and rotation, grid) with a tooltip on the Paint tool; the viewport shows painted tiles, a ghost preview of the brush, a chunk border and the collision rectangles of the selected layer; the bottom panel TileMap tab is the palette with atlas sources, the atlas with a two-tile pattern selected, and the alternative tiles.
svg.text: File Edit View Project Run Help
Paint the selected tiles. Shift: line,
click: tile · drag: pattern · Ctrl/Cmd+click: random set · wheel: zoom
Edit TileSet (switches to the TileSet tab)
Paint bar: shown while a TileMapLayer is selected in a 2D tab.
Ghost preview of the brush (editor-only node, not saved).
Chunk border: one canvas sub-item and one static body per chunk.
Selected layer's collision: full tiles merge per row run.
TileMap palette: a contextual tab of the bottom panel.
Pattern brush: a 2×1 selection dragged in the atlas.
Random set (dice tool): weighted by TileData.Probability.
AnimatedSprite2D, y-sorted with the Objects layer's tree tiles.
Painting a TileMapLayer (proposal G2b). Every tool is an icon button with a tooltip; numbered markers are annotations, not UI.
